workflow: Bundled imagegen CLI edit; no custom SDK runner.

reference_preparation.mask: expression facial area only; provider mask behavior is best-effort

requests.gate: only after sample-smile passes API, alpha and identity review

rights: Personal preview only. Original author and redistribution rights are unverified.
credential_policy: Temporary key provided only to the drawing process through masked input and environment; not persisted in project files, prompts, reports or packages.
http_attempt_count: Not independently observed; SDK standard retry behavior is distinct from image regeneration.

first_sample_review.provider_return: RGBA PNG, 1024x1536; genuine transparent pixels; fringe noise outside the silhouette
first_sample_review.local_processing: Only the model-produced facial expression is blended into the original native portrait.
first_sample_review.visual_review: Light/dark backgrounds and labeled static room composite inspected; identity and pose retained.

second_sample.provider_return: RGBA PNG, 1024x1536, genuine transparency; low-alpha detached fringe noise
second_sample.local_processing: Alpha-support cleanup of detached noise only, then transparent-margin crop; no repaint or second generation.
second_sample.visual_review: Identity/costume, hands and chopsticks, visible white rice, light/dark previews and labeled static-room foot alignment inspected.

next_step: Wait for the user to review both samples before any additional artwork generation, runtime code edits or packaging.
